traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets imagination. Strong imagination and intuitive, associative thinking. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Slippery memory and blurred facts; what's real and what's imagined get confused. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Thinking and imagination reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Creative ideation; verify the details before acting on them.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: A convincing account can start falling apart once it is compared with what was actually said, promised, or documented.

readerCopy.body: A convincing account can start falling apart once it is compared with what was actually said, promised, or documented. When Mercury opposes Neptune, facts and imagination pull against each other, making rumors, assumptions, selective memory, and emotionally satisfying explanations difficult to separate from the record. A story can feel true while containing details that were never confirmed. Clarity returns when the documented facts are allowed to stand without extra explanation being supplied on their behalf.
